book.name: Garatia
book.title: GARATIA Poru Gigirum Meuma Garatia Igiyawa Munan Tenewa

content: Gare veniwa mamaib. Kwan autanwa abnawa me kwan undag meumawa. Megara me ud torave wakenewa, me ankwatave nau aivi abnawa me mina ube onan.
Namu me amat abnawa ge kwan amaraivi abnawa ankwatave wakene, ivi mamawa baraune kumiwa uwape.
Nu mina meib. Nu ud toronub waketuwa, nu ankwatave nau ete igiyawa, piyu mame anoano meuma taibewa ankwatave wakeetewa.
Megara kum me uwane, God me Usiwa baraune onne, sira me ane me vesin gumbe yainewa ane, sira God ane me Gwangwan ankwatave abnawa ane.
Mame me Gwangwan ankwatave wakeeme igiyawa sira gwiruwag tamtan oya, sira meve nu usitainaven atan oya.
God me Usiwa Guwawa me waiviwa “Abba,
Maman,” nonunmagave baraune onne. Me gumbe, ye yaug anoyana ye God usitainawa.
Meoya ge gare mame di ankwatave nau aivi abnawa onan, megara usiwa. Ge usiwa ipewa, God ane ge kwan autanwa abnawa ana.
Poru Me Garatia Igiyawa Oya Anoivi
Namuiren, ye God den yaug anoyana kumiwa apa, ye god ugaugaeba ankwatave nau ene igiyawa. Ugauga godawa mu God natawa onan.

Megara gare mame ye God yaug anoyana, sira egave ne watan anoeniwa God me ye yauyen anone. Divi oya ye sira taig toewanewan taibewa me yusi onanwa ge natawa onanwa gumbe aisietan ene. Sira divi oya ye ankwatave nau ene igiyawa sira taig atan ene.
Ye oiyat, dud, bodu bairawan kumiwa ge bairawan amarene.
Ne yenan danadawai auveni, kuiyawa anten ne nau yenan anawa me nata onan eni go.
Tatangwanen, ne yusipamit diruieni, ne minan aya. Ne ye mine ana. Ye divi da kukaeba ne gunap den ayana.
Ye yaug anoyana, ne namuiren gae oraiwa ye guniyap wanawa, ne kwapunwa yusi onan oya.
Sira kwapunwa yuwatawa ibnawa yenne. Megara ye ne den yan barauneg topai negiyana. Megara God aneyaeba mina, Keriso Iesu membo mina, ye ne yauneg ne baigan anegiyana.
Megara gare mame degadega yeuma ampa? Ne natawa wag diruitna. Ye imuyap oma ape ipewa ye yangewa pukiyag nektan anoya.
Meib ipewa, ne natawa diruina oya ye anavi yeuma ana?
Mu yenan nau yusipamit emewa oraimina onan. Mu imuwo ye munan yusipamit anog ye nu gunup atan tetan oya eme.
Dividivi oraiwa gumbe yusipamit yenan anotanwa me evedni oraimina. Me ne guniyap wakenawa kumiwa mekut onan.
Ne utuntainanwa. Namu ne ud barautanwa gumbe yenan sira dawai aueni, ivi Keriso daneyap matatpe.
Meoya, ne gare ye guniyap wakepopo ipawa, nonwa tobiyag diruyempopo. Ne yenan danadawai aueni.
Vesin Eiga Ge Vesin Seira
Ye Gwangwan ankwatave waketan anoigimiya ipewa, garawapa wag didnegiya. Ye Gwangwan aninin waiviwa anoene go?
Me apa meib tene. Ebraam usitainawa duwam. Desirom me ankwatave wakene vesinawa gumbe yaine, sira dawa me ui onan vesinawa gumbe yaine.
Ankwatave wakene vesinawa usiwa me kwapiwa gumbe yaine, megara ui onan vesinawa usiwa me agi gumbe yaine.
Mame me maibe. Vesin duwam mame mu God agiyawa duwam. Desirom me tui Sainai apa onne, ud baraupe, sira mu ankwatave nau eme igiyawa ape. Vesin me Eiga.
Vesin mame Eiga me tui Sainai me at Arebia danave. Me gare mame Jerusarem. Kuiyawa vesin me ankwatave wakene vesinawa, usitainawa gaibu.
Megara Jerusarem me kwiminau wakenewa me ui onan yai wakeigimtanwa. Me nu inunwa.
Kuiyawa meib tene.

content.text: “Agara vesinawa me ud den teegewa, ge degadega aigima.
Vesin me ud teatanwa dauwaiba den yaug anoanawa,
Kuiyawa vesin me mekut wakeiviwa ud matai obiren tepe, vesin me memawa gaibuwa me mina onan.”

content: Tatangwanen, ye Aisak mina agi usitainawa.
Megara watavit kwapiwa gumbe yaig onne abnawa me Guwawa gumbe yaig onne abnawa edawai wanne. Gare mame me mina meib.
Megara Baiboru aninin waivi?

content.text: “Ankwatave nau aiviwa vesinawa ge usiwa atatai imiya. Kuiyawa ankwatave nau aiviwa vesinawa usiwa me kwan autanwa abnawa den ape ui onan vesinawa usiwa gaibu. Onan di.”

content: Meoya tatangwanen, nu ankwatave nau aivi vesinawa usitainawa onan, megara ui onan yai wakeiviwa vesinawa usitainawa.
